description: MCP server for TwinCAT 3 — browse/edit PLC source, read/write live ADS variables, and drive the XAE Shell's build/automation interface (Windows-only).
name: io.github.Adonuu/TwinCAT-MCP

environmentVariables.name: Runtime__AmsNetId
environmentVariables.description: AMS Net ID of the default ADS target for the Runtime scope, e.g. '127.0.0.1.1.1' for a local loopback runtime. Optional — falls back to the local runtime when unset.

environmentVariables.name: Runtime__AmsPort
environmentVariables.description: AMS port of the default ADS target — 851 is the standard TwinCAT 3 PLC runtime port.

environmentVariables.name: Automation__ShowIde
environmentVariables.description: Whether to make the XAE Shell window visible while the server drives it. Useful when developing/debugging; leave false otherwise.

environmentVariables.name: Safety__AllowAdsWrites
environmentVariables.description: When true, the agent may write live PLC variable values via ADS (write_symbol / write_symbols_batch). Defaults to false; can be changed live mid-session with the set_safety_toggles tool. See docs/SAFETY.md.

environmentVariables.name: Safety__AllowDownloads
environmentVariables.description: When true, the agent may download/activate a configuration to the runtime (activate_configuration) — the operation that stops, reloads, and restarts the PLC. Defaults to false; can be changed live mid-session with the set_safety_toggles tool. See docs/SAFETY.md.

environmentVariables.name: Safety__AllowRuntimeStateChanges
environmentVariables.description: When true, the agent may change runtime state: set_plc_state (Run/Stop/Reset/Config) and restart_twincat (cold restart). Defaults to false; can be changed live mid-session with the set_safety_toggles tool. See docs/SAFETY.md.
